title: 第六千一百二十六章 月之古树晋升第六千一百二十五章 五位维度之主围攻
content_zh:
青铜门外，月之古树的蜕变，已经持续了很久。
从毁灭时空战争真正打响开始，这棵扎根于时空通道中的古老巨树，便一直承受着三方规则冲刷。
它没有离开。
也没办法离开。
气的赵大虎和橘子皮打野一点办法都没有，最后俩人商量了一下，决定等林枫和赵凯俊把兵线推过来以后强打一波，然而，事实证明，他俩想太多了。
李红名去眼神一亮，手指捏了一个法诀，被摔飞在地上的长剑，“咻”的一声，犹如闪电一般的刺向了克林。
那就只能从角色本身着手了，说白了，就是林木名气比米樰大，也更容易吸引观众愿意为这部电影掏钱买票。
这样汇总起来一分析，不难看出，鄢郄党已经在做最后的准备了。他们应该在不久之后就要发起行动。
李红名心中这么一想，反而一惊，要不要继续看下去，看下去的话，李红名心中止不住的罪恶感突生。
许雯雯听说，人在紧张的时候，喝点水会有所缓解，她真的怕韩少勋会崩溃。
此前，暗主在被俘之时自爆的消息被传了出来，不少魔族也看到了那场爆炸，那范围并不大，显然是被暗主控制过的，那么他自爆所带来的破坏力是他们难以想象的。
陈晓动情的拉着张若风的手，这位前五星级球员泪流满面，他经历过万人追捧，也暗淡无光的在病床上住了半年，现在他洗尽铅华，重头再来。终于…闯进了他梦寐以求的8强。
王越怎么可能放弃，不过嘴上自然不能放松，否则被张良才看出端倪，拿捏住他的命脉，他怕不是要付出不少好处才行。
听到了徐破的话，陈潇也是直接点头，他知道，徐破这是摆明了不会帮杀万生了，这倒也不出陈潇预料，不管如何，杀万生和周龙三人的死有关联，这是关系着乾坤门荣辱的事情，神变门自然不好参与。
听到这话，陈潇也是眼神一闪，他瞬间就明白徐破的意思了，没有谁是能为了其他人平白无故付出的，付出和回报，向来都是成正比的，这一点无法保证，那么再好的关系，都是笑话。
“我在院中练习武技，听到街道车马喧哗，也想来瞧个热闹，不曾想是南山大哥，不知道发生了什么事，让你如此兴师动众？”见到是南山，夜阳也脸色缓和许多，抱拳行礼称道。
白鹿寒长舒口气，总算应付过去了，他自觉执法公正，量以后不会有人说三道四，斜眼瞟向屋顶，却发现颜仙儿早已不知不觉离开了。
身体上传出了一道神虚之力，直接注入了房间中的大阵上，立刻，陈潇带着云听雨的身影就直接消失。
山猫面露为难之色，“二公子，这些个世间俗事，您不必知道”。
眼前魔界位面的千万天使军团中，有超过六成都是辉耀之主的嫡系。

不多时几道隐匿在黑夜中的身影，从四周包围过来，形成合围之势，燕云城冷眼看着下面的一切，他们四人其中一人炼虚大圆满，三人炼虚后期。
现在江寒虽然被梵星火救了上来，可神器灭世与方山易，都已经消失不见。
又传出了一声闷响，花解语的左手几乎变形，而巨灵神只是晃动了几下身体。
“而且，在命名的时候，也得在另一面写下自己的功劳。”无名又补充道。
也就因为这个原因，“d”才被七曜的所有人都无比的恐惧，当然，星露则是一个例外。在所有的七曜成员之中，估计只有她，是唯一不会惧怕“d”的人物。
过了好长一阵时间，仍然不见音讯，云稹似乎有些按捺不住，不由地开始来回踱步。
只不过尴尬的是，在这种自顾不暇的时候，真的没有人去怜香惜玉，自损修为来为莜糖分担压力。
经过了大约有20分钟左右的时间，那根头发终于被连根的拔了出来，而此时莫离的衣衫，都已经被汗水给湿透了，汗珠嘀嗒嘀嗒了，从头上流下来，就好像雨点一样。
张承志拿出手机来翻出王红军的号码告诉给李牧野，末了说道：“军哥还是念旧的，你现在要是没什么负担，不如去投靠他，比留在这里强。”说罢，又叹了口气。
“这位同学，刚才的比赛真是太精彩了！以你的天赋，不来我们队，那简直是暴遣天物！对了，忘了说了，我是学校足球队的教练，我姓夏。”夏老师热情道。
老妖王身在阵法之中，没想到自己的感应反而被减弱了，也或许是太专注于唾手可得的圣物了吧。贪宝毙命。
凛音这句没头没脑的话，让叶岚也是感到古怪，自己的胸口，可是从来没有什么印记的，是不是自己胸口的什么伤口，让凛音一时紧张看错了呢？
“早上起来会特别腻老公啦，这样特别有爱。”李芸瑶吐吐舌头，有点害羞但是并没有多少不好意思，在家姐妹们经常这样，大家都很喜欢和他在一起的这种美好的充实，反正现在萱萱也已经是自己的姐妹了，自然没关系。
‘草民不敢，草民不敢。’艾长远声音颤抖的说道。他不仅声音在颤抖，浑身都在颤抖。
这次在安南的登陆战，允熥采用了一种并无前例的方式来集合水师。为了减轻一地供应军队补给的负担，他将水师船队分散在海口、海康、合浦三处，让他们于同日起航，在海上会合，会合后在安南沿海某一地登陆。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
Outside the bronze door, the transformation of the Ancient Moon Tree has been going on for a long time.
Since the beginning of the war to destroy time and space, this ancient giant tree rooted in the passage of time and space has been under the erosion of the three-party rules.
It didn't leave.
There is no way to leave.
Zhao Dahu and Orange Peel were so angry that they couldn't do anything about it. Finally, they discussed and decided to wait for Lin Feng and Zhao Kaijun to push the troops over and then attack forcefully. However, it turned out that they thought too much.
Li Hongming's eyes lit up, and he formed a magic formula with his fingers. The long sword that was thrown to the ground stabbed Klin like lightning with a "whoosh" sound.
Then we can only start with the character itself. To put it bluntly, even if Lin Mu is more famous than Mi Qiao, it is easier to attract audiences to pay for the movie.
After summarizing this analysis, it is not difficult to see that the Yanqie Party is already making final preparations. They should be taking action soon.
Li Hongming thought this and was shocked. Should he continue reading? If he continued reading, Li Hongming would feel an unstoppable sense of guilt.
Xu Wenwen heard that when people are nervous, drinking some water will relieve them. She is really afraid that Han Shaoxun will collapse.
Previously, the news that the Dark Lord self-destructed when he was captured was spread. Many demons also saw the explosion. The scope was not large, and it was obviously controlled by the Dark Lord. The destructive power caused by his self-destruction was unimaginable to them.
Chen Xiao held Zhang Ruofeng's hand emotionally, and the former five-star player burst into tears. He had experienced being sought after by thousands of people, and had lived in a hospital bed for half a year without any glory. Now he has washed away all his glory and started over. Finally... he broke into the top 8 that he had dreamed of.
How could Wang Yue give up, but he couldn't relax his words, otherwise Zhang Liangcai would see the clues and take hold of his lifeline, and he might have to pay a lot of benefits.
After hearing Xu Po's words, Chen Xiao also nodded directly. He knew that Xu Po had made it clear that he would not help kill Wan Sheng. This was not what Chen Xiao had expected. In any case, killing Wansheng was related to the death of Zhou Long and the others. This was a matter of honor and disgrace for the Qiankun Sect, and it was naturally difficult for the Shenbian Sect to get involved.
Hearing this, Chen Xiao's eyes flashed, and he instantly understood what Xu Po meant. No one can pay for others for no reason. Pay and reward have always been directly proportional. This cannot be guaranteed. No matter how good the relationship is, it is all a joke.
"I was practicing martial arts in the courtyard, and when I heard the noise of cars and horses on the street, I wanted to come and watch the excitement. I never thought it was Brother Nanshan. I wonder what happened to make you mobilize troops like this?" When he saw it was Nanshan, Ye Yang's face softened a lot, and he cupped his fists and saluted.
Bai Luhan breathed a sigh of relief and finally got over it. He consciously enforced the law fairly and expected that no one would make irresponsible remarks in the future. He glanced sideways at the roof, only to find that Yan Xianer had already left without knowing it.
A divine power came from his body and was directly injected into the large formation in the room. Immediately, Chen Xiao disappeared with Yun Tingyu.
Shanmao looked embarrassed and said, "Second Young Master, you don't need to know these common things in the world."
More than 60% of the tens of millions of angel legions in the demonic plane in front of us are direct descendants of the Lord of Glory.
Not long after, several figures hidden in the dark night surrounded them from all sides, forming an encirclement. Yan Yuncheng looked at everything below with cold eyes. One of the four of them had reached the Dzogchen stage of practice, and the other three had advanced stage of practice.
Although Jiang Han was rescued by Brahma Xinghuo now, the artifact Destruction of the World and Fang Shanyi have disappeared.
There was another muffled sound, and Hua Jieyu's left hand almost deformed, while the Giant Spirit God only shook his body a few times.
"Moreover, when naming, you have to write your own credit on the other side." Wuming added.
It is for this reason that "d" is extremely feared by everyone in Qiyao. Of course, Xingluis an exception. Among all the members of Qiyao, she is probably the only one who is not afraid of "d".
After a long time, there was still no news. Yunzhen seemed a little unable to hold himself back and began to pace back and forth involuntarily.
But the embarrassing thing is that at this time when they have too much time to take care of themselves, no one really cares about her and sacrifices her own cultivation to share the pressure for Youtang.
After about 20 minutes, the hair was finally pulled out. At this time, Mo Li's clothes were soaked with sweat. The sweat was dripping down from his head like raindrops.
Zhang Chengzhi took out his mobile phone, found out Wang Hongjun's number and told it to Li Muye, and finally said: "Brother Jun is still nostalgic. If you don't have any burden now, it's better to go to him than stay here." After that, he sighed again.
"This classmate, the game just now was so exciting! With your talent, if you don't join our team, it would be a waste of money! By the way, I forgot to mention, I am the coach of the school football team, and my surname is Xia." Teacher Xia said enthusiastically.
The old demon king was in the formation, but he didn't expect that his senses would be weakened instead. Maybe he was too focused on the holy objects that were within easy reach. Greedy for treasure leads to death.
Linyin's meaningless words made Ye Lan feel strange. There was never any mark on his chest. Was it some kind of wound on his chest that made Linyin nervous and misread it?
"I feel very tired of my husband when I wake up in the morning. It makes me so loving." Li Yunyao stuck out her tongue, a little shy but not too embarrassed. Sisters at home often do this. Everyone likes the wonderful enrichment of being with him. Anyway, Xuanxuan is already her sister, so it doesn't matter.
‘The grassroots people don’t dare, the grassroots people don’t dare. ’ Ai Changyuan said with a trembling voice. Not only was his voice trembling, but his whole body was trembling.
For this landing battle in Annan, Yunxi adopted an unprecedented method to gather the navy. In order to reduce the burden of supplying the army in one place, he dispersed the naval fleet in Haikou, Haikang, and Hepu, and asked them to set sail on the same day, meet at sea, and land somewhere along the coast of Annan after the rendezvous.
